column1: # Per-variant identity: what makes each TunaOS variant look like itself.
# Every variant is TunaOS first, but wears one accent colour borrowed from the
# distro it is built on, as a nod to that project: Arch blue for marlin,
# Ubuntu orange for grouper, openSUSE green for sailfin, and so on. The mark is
# Read by build_scripts/90-image-info.sh at build time and by
# scripts/branding/render-wallpapers.mjs when the wallpapers are regenerated.
# tests/bats/test_variant_identity.bats keeps it in step with build-config.
# gnome_accent is the nearest of GNOME's fixed accent names (blue teal green
# yellow orange red pink purple slate); GNOME cannot take an arbitrary colour.
